title: Binance P2P Adds Support for TRUMP Trading Pairs in Selected Fiat Zones
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance P2P  has added support for  OFFICIAL TRUMP (TRUMP).  Trading for TRUMP is now enabled against certain fiat currencies, which may include  BDT, CNY, COP, INR, PKR, USD, UAH, VES, and VND . Users can directly buy and sell TRUMP trading pairs using various local payment methods on Binance P2P. Start Trading Now!
